The boy followed the old man, but soon he started to feel very bad. He felt like he was not able to move and something was wrong.

his feet with every step and feeling sad. 

One day he saw a wink in the sky. The boy wondered what it was. He looked up and smiled.

"Maybe something good will happen to me," he said. 

He kept walking and walking, and soon he came upon an old man.
